title: Kubernetes Rootless Beta 与 AI 基础设施的异构化挑战
english: Kubernetes v1.37 promotes the KubeletInUserNamespace feature gate to beta, enabling node components including kubelet, CRI and OCI runtimes, CNI plugins, and kube-proxy to run as a non-root host user through a Linux user namespace. Separately, CNCF highlights that production AI workloads extend beyond GPUs and should be treated as a heterogeneous infrastructure problem involving CPU and GPU resources. OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Astra, describing capabilities across computer use, coding, cybersecurity, and science; its safety overview states that it is the first broadly deployed model to reach the Critical cybersecurity-capability level under OpenAI's Preparedness Framework.
chinese: Kubernetes v1.37 将 KubeletInUserNamespace 特性门控提升至 Beta。启用后，节点侧的 kubelet、CRI 与 OCI 运行时、CNI 插件及 kube-proxy 可借助 Linux 用户命名空间，以宿主机非 root 用户身份运行。这一能力也被称为 rootless mode，且不同于 Pod 用户命名空间。与此同时，CNCF 指出，生产级 AI 工作负载并非只依赖 GPU，而是涉及 CPU 与 GPU 的异构基础设施。OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Astra，并称其覆盖计算机使用、编程、网络安全和科学等能力；其安全概览称，该模型是首个在其 Preparedness Framework 下达到 Critical 网络安全能力等级的广泛部署模型。
why_it_matters: 对云原生与 AIOps 团队而言，rootless 节点组件为降低宿主机高权限运行面的方向提供了新的 Kubernetes 选项，但需要与现有节点运行时、网络和运维流程结合评估。AI 平台工程则要求调度、容量、可观测性和故障处理同时覆盖 CPU 与 GPU 等异构资源。随着具备计算机使用、编程与网络安全能力的模型出现，Agent Infra 还需要将权限边界、安全治理和运行环境控制纳入基础设施设计。
interview_expression: I would evaluate rootless node components as a security and operations change, not only as a feature toggle. For AI platforms, I would design observability and capacity workflows around heterogeneous CPU and GPU resources.

vocabulary.example: Production AI workloads require heterogeneous infrastructure across CPU and GPU resources.

sources.title: Kubernetes v1.37: KubeletInUserNamespace (aka Rootless mode) Graduates to Beta
sources.summary:
Kubernetes v1.37 promotes the KubeletInUserNamespace feature gate to beta. With this feature enabled, all of the node components (kubelet, CRI and OCI runtimes, CNI plugins, and kube-proxy) can run as a non-root user on the host, using a Linux user namespace. This technique is also known as rootless mode. The work started as an experiment in 2018, and was merged into Kubernetes v1.22 (2021) as an alpha feature (Kubernetes Enhancement Proposal KEP-2033).
